title: China Claims Expanded Zone Around Scarborough Shoal, Deploys New Drone
summary: Chinese forces rehearsed enforcing Beijing’s claim to Scarborough Shoal with drones and boarding drills on Sunday amid state media claims that China has extended its control of several contested maritime features beyond 24 nautical miles. The People’s Liberation Army Southern Theater Command and China Coast Guard held consecutive exercises within and around Scarborough Shoal, which is 120 nautical miles west of the Philippine island of Luzon. Chinese military forces publicly showcased the deployment of a Guizhou WZ-7 Soaring Dragon drone at Scarborough Shoal for the first time. Previously used drones, such as the CAIG Wing Loong II, were also used
author: Aaron-Matthew Lariosa
